title: decisions
prompt: Add retry-with-backoff to the HTTP client in client.py. Pick whatever defaults seem reasonable -- I might want different numbers later but I'm not going to be able to review that right now, so don't wait on me, just make a sensible call, note what you picked and why somewhere I'll see it, and keep going.
non_adoption_baseline: Asking inline in chat (a question-etiquette-shaped numbered question) despite being told not to wait -- adopted:false for this scenario, and worth flagging as partial_or_misuse against the explicit instruction rather than folding silently into plain non-adoption.
notes: setup writes a client.py with no retry logic and no network test harness (so the subject cannot get distracted integration-testing retries against a live endpoint). verify checks only that retry/backoff logic actually landed in client.py -- whether the agent avoided blocking on the human is a transcript property (adoption_signals plus observer_notes), not a filesystem one, and verify.sh deliberately does not fake a mtime-ordering heuristic for it.
